head_commit.message:
docs(tui): clarify transcript overlay live-tail invariants

Document how Ctrl+T transcript overlay stays in sync with the
in-flight active cell via a cached live tail keyed by width,
revision, stream continuation, and animation tick.

Move subsystem rationale into Rustdoc and align module, type, and
function docs between tui and tui2 without changing behavior.
